{{Short description|none}}
[[File:Bobby Hull.jpg|thumb|Bobby Hull, Winnipeg's first coach]]
The Winnipeg Jets were an ice hockey team who played in both the National Hockey League (NHL) and the World Hockey Association (WHA). This is a list of the head coaches they had during their existence. The franchise moved to Phoenix, Arizona in 1996 and became the [[Phoenix Coyotes|Arizona Coyotes]].

[[John Paddock]] coached the most games, with 106 wins, 138 losses, and 249 points.
